name: ip-api
tagline: IP geolocation API for location, ISP, and timezone data
description: ip-api provides free and paid IP geolocation lookups returning country, region, city, coordinates, ISP, timezone, and related network data. Non-commercial use has a free HTTP endpoint with rate limits; commercial use requires a paid Pro plan with HTTPS and higher limits.

auth.details: Free tier requires no API key (non-commercial only). Pro tier uses API key via path or query parameter after paid signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 45 requests per minute from an IP (non-commercial use only); HTTPS not available on free tier
pricing.paid_plans: Pro plans available for commercial use with HTTPS, higher rate limits, and bulk endpoints

rate_limits: Free: 45 requests per minute per IP. Pro limits depend on plan.
use_cases: get country and city from an IP
detect ISP and organization for an IP
resolve timezone for an IP address
batch-lookup multiple IPs on Pro plan
